description: This file defines the SettingsProvider class, which manages user preferences such as font size, theme mode, and backend override URL for an application. It interacts with a StorageService to persist and retrieve these settings, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: SettingsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass that manages user preferences such as font size, theme mode, and backend override URL.

methods.name: SettingsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preferences from StorageService.

methods.name: get fontScale
methods.description: Retrieves the current font scale value.

methods.name: get themeMode
methods.description: Returns the ThemeMode based on the current theme setting.

methods.name: get backendOverride
methods.description: Returns the backend override URL if set.

methods.name: setFontScale
methods.description: Sets a new font scale value, updates storage, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets a new theme mode, updates storage, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setBackendOverride
methods.description: Sets or clears the backend override URL, updates storage, and notifies listeners.
